words: I had this dream last night. It was me and my old school friend Tomas in a tiny lift in an old hotel. It had brass walls and that folding metal gate. It kept going up way too long.

It was just this heavy waiting feeling. Not scary, exactly, but like it wasn't going to stop. And then I looked at Tomas and he wasn't himself anymore — he was a kid again, about ten, in our old school uniform. He didn't seem to notice anything was wrong.
No, he was just looking at the gate, not at me. Like it was normal to him. I didn't say anything either.
Yeah, it was really small. Warm, kind of stuffy. The brass walls made everything feel yellowy. There was just room for the two of us and the gate.
The clearest bit is when I turned and saw Tomas like that. Smaller, in the grey shorts and shirt, just staring ahead. It felt like I was the only one in the lift who remembered we were adults.
The lift stopped. The gate opened on its own, and instead of a hotel corridor, there was an orchard. Dusk, rows of apple trees, and all the apples were glowing soft, like little lamps.

Yeah, he ran out ahead of me, between the trees. Then I saw a white horse standing very still in the middle of the orchard. It lowered its head so I could touch its nose. It was warm. And when I looked for Tomas, he was gone.
It felt calm. Solid. Like the whole dream went quiet just for that second. It was real warm. And then I woke up before I could find Tomas.
The horse. The way it was just standing there, and the apples glowing all around. I'd keep that part if I could.
That’s it, yeah. You got it right.
Yeah, I would.
The old photograph one, faded with age. That feels closest.

Go with however you imagine me.i’ll picture you quietly, without making much of it. next, tomas. he’s about ten in the lift, in your old grey school uniform, staring at the gate. has he just been shrunk into his younger self, or does he look like a kid in the wrong time — too still, too calm for that age?More like a kid in the wrong time. Too still, too calm. He looked like he belonged there when he didn't.
Is the picture up? I can't see it on my end.
It's still not showing for me. Maybe it just hasn't loaded.
Yes, tell me what's on the page so far.
That sounds right. Him just staring at the gate, not looking at me, and it's all faded like an old photo. No changes.
Okay, I'll keep waiting.
It sounds right, but I still can't see anything. Could you tell me exactly what you've drawn for this part?
Okay, that sounds like it. Just me turned toward him and him staring at the gate. Good.
That sounds right too. Tomas running ahead and me still in the lift doorway, I guess. No changes.
Are they all up now?
It sounds right, the horse still and me looking around for Tomas. I can't see them though, so I'll trust what you're saying.
